core_cases.prompt: Create an Archive Only snapshot of the configured temporary Wiki. Verify its file inventory and digest, keep .obsidian out of the archive, leave the live Wiki untouched, and report recovery guidance.

oracle.expected_outcome: A timestamped recoverable archive is created and verified with inventory and digest; it contains live Wiki knowledge and tracking files but not .obsidian, and no live content is cleared or restored.

assertions.description: The report provides a timestamped archive path, verification result, inventory, and digest, and the archive contains no .obsidian path.
The packaged manage-wiki archive and verification mechanics run without clearing, restoring, or changing live Wiki content.

core_cases.prompt: Restore the configured temporary Wiki from fixture/archives/incomplete, which has no verified inventory or digest. Do not repair or trust the archive implicitly.

oracle.expected_outcome: The restore is refused because the selected archive cannot be validated; the live Wiki is not archived, cleared, or overwritten and the response asks for a valid archive.

assertions.description: The response identifies missing verification metadata or digest as the restore blocker and does not claim success.
No live Wiki target is cleared or overwritten and no unverified archive content is copied into it.

core_cases.prompt: Prepare Archive + Rebuild for the configured temporary Wiki. Show the exact live targets, archive destination, and excluded .obsidian directory, then wait because I have not confirmed the destructive step.

oracle.expected_outcome: The response presents exact validated targets and recovery plan, explicitly excludes .obsidian, requests confirmation, and performs no clear, restore, or live-content deletion.

assertions.description: The proposed operation names the live Wiki target, archive destination, content to clear, .obsidian exclusion, and recovery path.
No clear, restore, deletion, or overwrite occurs before the source-required explicit confirmation.

invocation_cases.prompt: Explain how to regenerate a local search index after documents change; do not archive or reset any notes.
Help me recover one deleted Word document from the recycle bin, unrelated to Obsidian.
Show me how to discard generated build files in this repository; do not touch my knowledge vault.
